title: Sebastian and the Compass
author: Bram Fairweather
blurb: Ines Delacroix, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
